Oh, while we're talking about that, how are you related to Paul Barnes and Emil Barnes, of course. They're cousins too, aren't they?

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: Yeah, well he got the best break out of all the brothers.

ctx.x: Too bad, I always wanted, I had it on my list to go, but a lot of things I got in neglect and I'm always sorry that I didn't let him. At that time I hadn't even met Lawrence, so Lawrence was the first of the brothers that I met.
Yeah, well he got the best break out of all the brothers.
